headline: Palworld tower bosses: the later fights
title: How to Beat Palworld Tower Bosses Part 2 | Shadowbeak, Bastigor, Shaolong, Astralym | Palworld Guide
video_script: Ready for the harder Palworld tower bosses? Victor and Shadowbeak: Shadowbeak is Dark, so bring Dragon Pals. Bjorn and Bastigor in Feybreak: Bastigor is Ice, so bring Fire. Auri and Shaolong: Shaolong is Water and Dragon, so Electric and Ice Pals work best. And the final fight, Zenara and Astralym, has no element at all, so there's no weakness. Just bring your strongest team and a lot of damage. Have you beaten Zenara yet? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 later tower bosses: Victor & Shadowbeak (Dark, use Dragon), Bjorn & Bastigor (Ice, use Fire), Auri & Shaolong (Water/Dragon, use Electric or Ice), Zenara & Astralym (typeless, no weakness).
